summary: The red team reports no findings, so there is no verdict to give. I tested its clean result, and every claim I tested holds. The accepted RS-25 (data/restructure copy identical to the research copy) has 13 member stages (R11.1–R11.6 kept, SF.0/SF.1/SF.4 narrowed, SF.2/SF.3/SF.5/SF.6 kept), 60 links and 25 owners. Every direct consumer of a narrowed layer (six of SF.0, four each of SF.1 and SF.4) receives a link from every named supplier, and every supplier links to its narrowed layer. The special cases attributed to Tau Ceti owners are literally planned there. StableReduction Layer 2 has 'relative `Proj` of a finitely generated graded quasi-coherent algebra' and 'effective étale descent for schemes equipped with a compatible relatively ample invertible sheaf'. ModularCurves 0E lists the effective descent classes that SF.1 now imports. In the production graph (scripts.build.assemble: 2840 stages, 8007 edges) all 60 RS-25 links are live and the graph has no directed cycle. TauCeti.NumericalType.weightedIntersection exists at f790474 (StableReduction/Picard/Basic.lean:107). No new observation.
